`recordUpstreamObservation` (#5255/#5176) updates only sources.upstream_checked_at, upstream_commit and upstream_behind, observations of the checkout's Git upstream outside managed_writer_guard's protected topology and checkpoint tuples; no page, fact or file is written, and a failure never fails the sync.

classifyMirrorPage stamps pages.database_only_reason=mirror_read_only only inside the coordinator publication transaction of a page write that published no file into a read-only mirror source (#5409), as classifyUnboundPage does for unbound sources.

`gbrain sources refresh` (F0) is the one sanctioned managed Git writer: it fast-forwards the checkout only under the worktree native lock after admission refused and claims stopped every checkout write (`fenced`), then updates only sources.upstream_checked_at/upstream_commit/upstream_behind in the merged bookkeeping transaction; pages and the checkpoint advance through the ordinary managed --no-pull sync.
